stem: One **difference** between “Soaring to New Heights” and “See It Through” is that only “See It Through” —

options.label: A
options.text: shows how problems caused by a physical challenge become less important over time

options.label: B
options.text: illustrates how certain activities can enhance the quality of a person’s life

options.label: C
options.text: tells of the athletic accomplishments of a person who has limited mobility

options.label: D
options.text: describes a personal experience of living with someone who is disabled
